meta.name: rag-architect
meta.description: Designs and implements production-grade RAG systems by chunking documents, generating embeddings, configuring vector stores, building hybrid search pipelines, applying reranking, and evaluating retrieval quality. Use when building RAG systems, vector databases, or knowledge-grounded AI applications requiring semantic search, document retrieval, context augmentation, similarity search, or embedding-based indexing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建生产级检索增强系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在构建需要从文档中检索知识来回答问题的AI应用。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI apps that answer questions from your own documents.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按固定流程设计 RAG 系统：分析检索需求、选向量库、定分块策略、搭混合检索管道（向量+关键词+重排序），再用 precision@k 等指标评估，输出架构图、选型分析和评估计划。
howto.when: 当你要求构建 RAG 系统、向量数据库，或涉及语义搜索、文档检索、知识库等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 RAG 系统，文档需要分块和向量化。
say.note: Claude 会分析需求并给出分块与向量库选型。

say.text: 用混合检索加重排序搭建知识库问答管道。
say.note: Claude 会设计检索管道并说明融合策略。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a fixed workflow to design RAG systems: analyze needs, choose vector DB, set chunking, build hybrid retrieval with reranking, and evaluate quality. Outputs include architecture diagrams, DB trade-offs, and an evaluation plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build RAG systems, vector databases, or semantic search / document retrieval / knowledge base applications.

say_en.text: Design a RAG system for my documents, including chunking and embeddings.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes needs and suggests chunking and vector store choices.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge-base QA pipeline with hybrid search and reranking.
say_en.note: Claude designs the retrieval pipeline and explains fusion.

say_en.text: How should I evaluate retrieval quality? Give me an evaluation plan.
